annotation.title_clean: European Parliament legislative resolution on the proposal for a directive amending Directive 97/68/EC on emissions from internal combustion engines in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: European Parliament legislative resolution on the proposal for a directive amending Directive 97/68/EC on emissions from internal combustion engines in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities C 87 E
annotation.summary_en: Official Journal excerpt of a 2001 European Parliament legislative resolution approving, as amended, a Commission proposal amending Directive 97/68/EC on pollutant emissions from engines in non-road mobile machinery, plus an amendment on ECSC Treaty expiry financial consequences. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Parliament approves the Commission proposal amending Directive 97/68/EC as amended
Asks to be consulted again if the proposal is substantially amended
Forwards position to Council and Commission
Separate item: amendment on ECSC Treaty expiry and Research Fund for Coal and Steel
